source: If you use Vite+, its {0} configures Vite+ commands such as {1}, {2}, and {3}. Nuxt doesn't read Vite options from this file, so configure Vite for your app with the {4} key in {5}.
text: Wenn du Vite+ verwendest, konfiguriert dessen {0} die Vite+-Befehle wie {1}, {2} und {3}. Nuxt liest keine Vite-Optionen aus dieser Datei. Konfiguriere Vite für deine App daher über den Schlüssel {4} in {5}.
